accepted_assessments.full_covariance: C is the saved16-coordinate origin covariance root, Sigma=C C^T. Exact propagates the complete ordered-prefix Jacobian F. Width=100||F[0]C|| in SOC percentage points. Same-anchor root=L chol(P)^-T uses the same original prior once. Independent contractions with Sigma and analytic j=(1,0,0,0,0,A exp(-logQ),0,...) agree; diagonal replacement would change tested SDs by as much as a factor3.81.
accepted_assessments.identity_and_preservation: All87 registered primary/follow-up source identities match, mapping original run.py to preserved versions/run_r1.py. All original review-bound run artifacts and compact summary match. Original README matches versions/README_r1.md byte-for-byte. Supplement source/protocol, recipes, observations, binaries, saved cases and factor snapshots verify. Only two expected README bindings changed relative to r1.
accepted_assessments.support_and_status: All81 selected fits yield local readouts;77 remain numerically converged and4 unresolved. All69 compressed transports are supported on these data. Fit-to-fit references appear for60 rows only;21 rows preserve unresolved candidate/reference status. Unresolved widths are labeled local diagnostics, never accepted fit comparisons. The readout does not refit or bypass a fit support failure.
accepted_assessments.truth_ownership_chronology: StimulusStream is used only to regenerate hash-matched observations; hidden outputs are discarded. One chronological prefix is evaluated from the original chart, preserving actual intervals and state. The direct objective computes alternative precision and transport for comparison, never as evidence combined with a compressed posterior. All prior/covariance coordinates and cross terms remain intact.
accepted_assessments.report: The revised report correctly distinguishes0.52436579 same-anchor and0.58326832 fit-to-fit SOC width ratios for one-hour embedded R5_H2; H7 ratios are0.99943166 and0.99941298. Direct/compressed SOC transport agreement locates this width discrepancy in covariance/anchor, not an omitted transport cross term. Existing Q/forecast/precision and resource claims remain within the unchanged r1-verified evidence. Rest stays prior-supported; no accuracy/coverage or deployment promotion is inferred.
accepted_assessments.prior_reviews: Original r1 accepts numerical interpretation, fitted-query/forecast arithmetic, source ownership, common support, complete covariance, unresolved-fit preservation and finite resource accounting except INT-R1-01. Candidate and RC5 reviews separately accept their class/math scope. Their unchanged hashes and preserved evidence support carrying those limited assessments into this integration acceptance.

import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np
from experiments.foster_campaign_001.backend import identity
from experiments.foster_campaign_001.compact import StimulusStream
from experiments.foster_feedback_001.estimator import Model
from experiments.slow_likelihood_diagnostic_001.numerics import Exact
P=Path('provenance/hysteresis_mixed_completion_001')
old=json.loads((P/'controls_review_r1.json').read_text()); saved=json.loads((P/'soc_widths.json').read_text()); fresh=json.loads(Path('/tmp/mixed_completion_soc_review_r2_reproduction.json').read_text())
assert saved==fresh, 'full supplement reproduction differs'
changes=[]
for name,expected in old['source_bindings'].items():
 if identity(Path(name))!=expected:changes.append(name)
assert set(changes)=={'provenance/hysteresis_mixed_completion_001/README.md','experiments/hysteresis_mixed_completion_001/README.md'}, changes
assert identity(P/'versions/README_r1.md')==old['source_bindings'][str(P/'README.md')]
for name,expected in old['checks'][1]['results']['verified_run_bindings'].items():assert identity(Path(name))==expected
for name,expected in saved['source']['sources'].items():assert identity(Path(name))==expected
assert identity(Path('specifications/hysteresis_mixed_completion_001/SOC_WIDTH_SUPPLEMENT.md'))==saved['protocol']
metrics=dict(rows=0,max_full_covariance_SOC_SD_gap_pp=0.,max_independent_same_anchor_SOC_SD_gap_pp=0.,max_independent_same_anchor_SOC_SD_relative_gap=0.,max_analytic_SOC_Jacobian_gap=0.,max_root_vs_full_covariance_variance_relative_gap=0.,max_diagonal_vs_full_SOC_SD_ratio_difference=0.,supplement_exact_reproduction=True,original_run_bindings_unchanged=True)
statuses=Counter();fit_to_fit=Counter();source_checks=0
for run in saved['runs']:
 directory=Path(run['run']);reg=json.loads((directory/'registration.json').read_text());manifest=json.loads((directory/'summary.json').read_text())
 for name,expected in reg['source']['sources'].items():
  mapped=P/'versions/run_r1.py' if directory.name=='full001' and name=='experiments/hysteresis_mixed_completion_001/run.py' else Path(name)
  assert identity(mapped)==expected,(name,mapped);source_checks+=1
 mean=np.array(reg['prior_mean']);L=np.array(reg['prior_root']);model=Model(directory/'backend_c/estimator.so',reg['config'])
 indexed={(r['load'],r['records'],r['arm']):r for r in run['rows']}
 for case in manifest['cases']:
  data=json.loads((directory/case['file']).read_text());baseline=json.loads(Path(data['baseline_result']['path']).read_text());recipe=baseline['recipe'];stream=StimulusStream(reg['config'],recipe['cell'],recipe['case'],recipe['settings']);chunks=[]
  for prefix in data['prefixes']:
   while stream.index<prefix['records']:
    obs,_,_=stream.read(min(999,prefix['records']-stream.index));chunks.append(obs.copy())
   observations=np.vstack(chunks)
   assert np.all(observations[:,2]==25.) and reg['config']['reference_temperature_K']==298.15
   # At the registered reference temperature the capacity Arrhenius factor is 1.
   charge=np.sum(observations[:,0]*observations[:,1])/3600
   objective=Exact(model,observations,mean,L,chunk=777)
   direct_converged=prefix['fits']['arms']['direct']['status']=='converged'
   for name,fit in prefix['fits']['arms'].items():
    row=indexed[data['load'],prefix['records'],name];metrics['rows']+=1;statuses[fit['status']]+=1
    assert row['fit_status']==fit['status']
    x=np.array(fit['selected']['x']);w=np.array(fit['selected']['w']);C=np.array(fit['selected']['root']);cov=C@C.T
    j=np.zeros(16);j[0]=1;j[5]=charge*np.exp(-x[5])
    variance=float(j@cov@j);rootvariance=float(np.linalg.norm(j@C)**2)
    metrics['max_root_vs_full_covariance_variance_relative_gap']=max(metrics['max_root_vs_full_covariance_variance_relative_gap'],abs(variance/rootvariance-1))
    sd=100*np.sqrt(variance);np.testing.assert_allclose(sd,row['direct_transport_SOC_SD_pp'],rtol=1e-8,atol=1e-10)
    metrics['max_full_covariance_SOC_SD_gap_pp']=max(metrics['max_full_covariance_SOC_SD_gap_pp'],abs(sd-row['direct_transport_SOC_SD_pp']))
    _,_,precision,_,F=objective(w);metrics['max_analytic_SOC_Jacobian_gap']=max(metrics['max_analytic_SOC_Jacobian_gap'],float(np.max(abs(F[0]-j))))
    b=j@L;directsd=100*np.sqrt(b@np.linalg.solve(precision,b))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(directsd,row['direct_same_anchor_SOC_SD_pp'],rtol=2e-5,atol=1e-10)
    metrics['max_independent_same_anchor_SOC_SD_relative_gap']=max(metrics['max_independent_same_anchor_SOC_SD_relative_gap'],abs(directsd/row['direct_same_anchor_SOC_SD_pp']-1))
    metrics['max_independent_same_anchor_SOC_SD_gap_pp']=max(metrics['max_independent_same_anchor_SOC_SD_gap_pp'],abs(directsd-row['direct_same_anchor_SOC_SD_pp']))
    diagonal=100*np.sqrt(np.sum(j*j*np.diag(cov)))
    metrics['max_diagonal_vs_full_SOC_SD_ratio_difference']=max(metrics['max_diagonal_vs_full_SOC_SD_ratio_difference'],abs(diagonal/sd-1))
    should_compare=direct_converged and fit['status']=='converged'
    assert ('reference_fit_SOC_SD_pp' in row)==should_compare
    fit_to_fit['available' if should_compare else 'unresolved_candidate_or_reference']+=1
    if 'compressed_transport_SOC_SD_pp' in row:np.testing.assert_allclose(sd,row['compressed_transport_SOC_SD_pp'],rtol=1e-8,atol=1e-10)
metrics.update(fit_statuses=dict(statuses),fit_to_fit_statuses=dict(fit_to_fit),registered_sources_verified=source_checks,original_source_binding_changes=changes)
metrics['quoted_embedded_126000']=[r for r in saved['runs'][1]['rows'] if r['load']=='embedded' and r['arm'] in ('R5_H2','R5_H7')]
print(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2))
